plotCards.title: Plot cards
plotCards.description: An add-on in which the leader draws Plot cards at the start of every mission and deals them to the other players. The cards reveal information about roles or change the course of the round: taking over the lead, cancelling a vote, peeking at a mission card.

settings.inquisitorFailed: Could not change the Inquisitor setting.

inquisitor.title: Inquisitor
inquisitor.description: A module in which a public token passes between players. After missions 2, 3 and 4 the token holder picks a player who never held it, privately learns whether they are a Spy or Resistance, and the token passes to that player. The Inquisitor may tell the others anything about it. Works best with 7 or more players.

settings.blindSpiesFailed: Could not change the Blind Spies setting.

blindSpies.title: Blind Spies
blindSpies.description: A variant in which the spies do not get to know each other. Each spy only knows their own role, so a spy has to work out who is on their side. Nothing in the app stops the spies from talking, so agree not to.

settings.reverserFailed: Could not change the Reverser setting.

reverser.title: Reverser
reverser.description: A module in which a secret Reverser character is dealt, by default to one player among the Resistance and one among the Spies (you can choose just one side). A Reverser on the mission team also holds a Reverse card, which turns the result of the mission around: a mission that would fail succeeds, and one that would succeed fails. Two Reverse cards cancel out. A Reverser who is a spy can never play Fail. The played cards, Reverse included, are shown without saying who played them.
reverser.sidesBoth: Both sides (the Resistance and the Spies)
reverser.spyKnowsSpies: Spy Reverser knows the other spies

settings.defectorFailed: Could not change the Defector setting.

defector.title: Defector
defector.description: A module in which two secret Defectors are dealt, one on the Resistance side and one among the Spies. At the start of missions 3, 4 and 5 a switch card is flipped for everyone to see: on Change Allegiance both Defectors change sides (they have to play by the rules of their new side and the win conditions follow), on No Change nothing happens. Nobody is told who the Defectors are, only that a switch happened. The Defector spy does not know the other spies, but they know him as long as he is among them.

settings.assassinFailed: Could not change the Assassin setting.

assassin.title: Assassin
assassin.description: A module in which a secret Commander (Resistance) and a secret Assassin (spy) are dealt. The Commander knows who the spies are. After the Resistance wins three missions the Spies get one last chance: the Assassin, after talking it over with the other spies outside the app, names the player they take for the Commander. If right, the Spies win; if wrong, the Resistance wins. Three failed missions still win the game for the Spies. Does not combine with Blind Spies, the Reverser or the Defectors. Optional characters (best one at a time): the Body Guard knows the Commander (with 5 players needs Deep Cover or the False Commander), Deep Cover is a spy the Commander does not see, the Blind Spy knows no spy and is known to none, the False Commander looks like the Commander to the Body Guard. The Assassin takes one spy seat, the other spy characters the rest.
assassin.tooManySpyCharacters: There are too few spies for these characters: the Assassin takes one spy seat, and Deep Cover, the Blind Spy and the False Commander one each.
assassin.bodyGuardNeedsCover: With 5 players the Body Guard needs Deep Cover or the False Commander.

OverheardConversation.name: Overheard Conversation
OverheardConversation.effect: Play immediately: look at the identity card of one of the players sitting next to you.

OpinionMaker.name: Opinion Maker
OpinionMaker.effect: Stays until the end of the game: you choose and reveal your Vote card before the others.

EstablishConfidence.name: Establish Confidence
EstablishConfidence.effect: Play immediately: the leader shows their identity card to another player.

OpenUp.name: Open Up
OpenUp.effect: Play immediately: show your identity card to another player (it may be the leader).

NoConfidence.name: No Confidence
NoConfidence.effect: One-time: reject an approved team, the vote counts as failed.

KeepingCloseEye.name: Keeping a Close Eye on You
KeepingCloseEye.effect: One-time: after the mission cards are played, look at one of the cards played.

StrongLeader.name: Strong Leader
StrongLeader.effect: One-time: take over the lead before the leader does anything.

InTheSpotlight.name: In the Spotlight
InTheSpotlight.effect: One-time: force another player to play their mission card openly.

TakeResponsibility.name: Take Responsibility
TakeResponsibility.effect: One-time: take another player's Plot card.

goal.title: Goal
goal.text: The players are secretly split into the Resistance and the Spies. At most 5 missions are played, and the team that scores 3 points first wins. The spies know each other, the Resistance does not know who the spies are.

round.title: A round
round.text: The leader picks a team of the required size (they may pick themselves). Everyone discusses, then votes simultaneously and openly: Approve or Reject. A tie rejects the team, and the lead passes on.

mission.title: The mission
mission.text: Each member of the approved team secretly plays a Success or a Fail card. The Resistance must play Success, a spy may play either. The mission fails if at least one Fail card was played (in mission 4 with 7 or more players two are needed).

plot.title: Plot cards (add-on)
plot.text: If the host enables the add-on before the game is opened, the leader draws Plot cards at the start of every mission (not after a rejected team): 1 with 5-6 players, 2 with 7-8, 3 with 9-10, and deals them to the other players (the “Establish Confidence” card stays with the leader). The number of cards in every player's hand is public, the cards themselves are secret, and everyone sees every card played.

makers.name: Opinion Maker
makers.text: goes on the table at once. Its owner votes on the team first, openly and without changing it; two Opinion Makers vote at the same time.

immediate.name: Overheard Conversation, Establish Confidence, Open Up
immediate.text: are played at once. The chosen player (or neighbour) sees an identity card and confirms it with a button.

strongLeader.name: Strong Leader
strongLeader.text: takes over the lead before the leader does anything.

noConfidence.name: No Confidence
noConfidence.text: rejects an approved team; it counts as a rejected team.

spotlight.name: In the Spotlight
spotlight.text: forces a team member to play their mission card openly.

take.name: Take Responsibility
take.text: takes a Plot card from another player (the visible Opinion Maker or a random card from the hand).

closeEye.name: Keeping a Close Eye on You
closeEye.text: after the mission (before “Next”) lets you look at another player's mission card.

plot.footer: When anyone holds a card (other than the Opinion Maker), everyone confirms before the team is picked or after it is approved that they are not playing a card, so nobody can tell who holds one.

end.title: End of the game
end.text: The Resistance wins after 3 successful missions. The Spies win after 3 failed missions or when 5 teams in a row are rejected in one mission.

blindSpies.title: Blind Spies (variant)
blindSpies.text: When the host enables the variant, the spies are not shown to each other at the start of the game: a spy sees only their own role and has to guess who the other spies are.

reverser.title: Reverser (module)
reverser.text: When the host enables the module, secret Reversers are dealt: by default one among the Resistance and one among the Spies, or only on the side the host chose. A Reverser on a mission team may play a Reverse card instead of Success. An odd number of Reverse cards turns the result of the mission around (it fails if it would have succeeded and the other way round), two cancel out; on the mission that needs two Fails, one Fail with one Reverse is a failure. A spy Reverser plays Success or Reverse, never Fail. Once the mission ends, the played cards (Fail and Reverse ones too) are shown without saying who played them.

defector.title: Defectors (module)
defector.text: When the host enables the module, two secret Defectors are dealt: one on the Resistance side and one among the Spies. A deck of five switch cards (three No Change, two Change Allegiance) is shuffled, and at the start of missions 3, 4 and 5 one card is flipped for everyone to see. On Change Allegiance both Defectors change sides: the former spy is now Resistance and plays only Success, the former Resistance Defector is now a spy and may play Fail, and the win conditions follow the new sides. A Defector spy keeps their eyes closed in the reveal, so they know no spy, while the other spies know them as long as they are among them. The Defector who started on the Resistance side is never known to the spies. With the variant the host may choose, the Defectors know each other. Revealed identities show the current side, never the character.

inquisitor.title: Inquisitor (module)
inquisitor.text: When the host enables the module, a public Inquisitor token starts with the player to the right of the first leader. After missions 2, 3 and 4 the holder picks a player who never held the token and privately sees whether that player is a Spy or Resistance; the token passes to the examined player. The Inquisitor may say anything about the result, and nobody can check it. The module is skipped when the game ends after mission 3 or 4.

assassin.title: Assassin (module)
assassin.text: When the host enables the module, a secret Commander is dealt among the Resistance and a secret Assassin among the Spies. The Commander knows who the spies are. If the Spies fail three missions they win as usual. If the Resistance wins three missions, the game is not over yet: the Spies talk it over outside the app and the Assassin names the player they take for the Commander. If they are right, the Spies win; otherwise the Resistance wins. The module does not combine with Blind Spies, the Reverser or the Defectors. Optional characters: the Body Guard (Resistance) knows the Commander, and with 5 players needs Deep Cover or the False Commander; Deep Cover (spy) is not seen by the Commander; the Blind Spy (spy) knows no other spy and is not known by them, though the Commander sees them; the False Commander (spy) looks like the Commander to the Body Guard. They are best played one at a time, and the Assassin takes one spy seat, so with 5 or 6 players only one spy character fits.

base.title: Base game

cardBack.name: Card back
cardBack.meaning: Your role card, face down. Tap it to see your role; tap again to hide it.

base.spy: Your role card: you are a Spy. You know the other spies (unless the Blind Spies variant is on), and you may play Success or Fail on a mission.
base.resistance: Your role card: you are in the Resistance. You do not know who the spies are and you may only play Success.

spyMarker.name: Fellow spy
spyMarker.meaning: Marks another spy in the list a spy sees on their role card.

base.leader: The leader of the current round picks the mission team. The lead passes to the next player after every team vote.
base.approve: Vote card: you accept the proposed team. Everyone votes at once and openly.
base.reject: Vote card: you refuse the proposed team. A tie rejects it; 5 rejected teams in a row win the game for the Spies.
base.success: Mission card: the mission goes well. The only card a Resistance member may play.
base.fail: Mission card: sabotage. Only a spy may play it; one Fail is enough to fail the mission (two in mission 4 with 7 or more players).

plot.note: Add-on: the host enables it before the game is opened. The effects below are the ones shown on the cards.

inquisitor.token: The token passes from player to player. After missions 2, 3 and 4 its holder privately sees whether a player who never held it is a Spy or Resistance, and the token moves to that player.

reverser.character: Your secret character card: you are a Reverser and may play a Reverse card on a mission. A spy Reverser never plays Fail.
reverser.card: Mission card: an odd number of Reverse cards turns the result of the mission around, two cancel out. Only a Reverser can play it, but everyone on the team holds one.

defector.character: Your secret character card: you are a Defector. Your side can change when a switch card is flipped at the start of mission 3, 4 or 5, so look at your role card again after every flip.

change.name: Switch card: Change Allegiance
change.meaning: Flipped at the start of a mission for everyone to see: both Defectors change sides. Nobody is told who they are.

noChange.name: Switch card: No Change
noChange.meaning: Flipped at the start of a mission for everyone to see: nothing happens, nobody changes sides.

assassin.commander: Your secret character card: you are the Commander of the Resistance and you know who the spies are. If the Resistance wins three missions, the Assassin tries to name you.
assassin.assassin: Your secret character card: you are the Assassin, a spy. If the Resistance wins three missions, you name the player you take for the Commander; if you are right, the Spies win.
assassin.bodyGuard: Your secret character card: you are the Body Guard of the Resistance. The Commander is one of two players you see, because the False Commander, if played, looks like the Commander to you.
assassin.deepCover: Your secret character card: you are Deep Cover, a spy the Commander does not see.
assassin.blindSpy: Your secret character card: you are the Blind Spy. You know no other spy and they do not know you, but the Commander sees you.
